title: Spring greens and white beans with eggs

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Leeks, tinned beans, stock, greens, eggs, hard cheese and bread are all plain cupboard, fridge and garden foods.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream UK supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a wide lidded pan and a grater, and cooking eggs in dips is within a beginner's reach.

works.reason: Two tins of beans, 250g greens, an egg each and bread make a sensible lunch for four, with enough liquid for the eggs to poach under the lid.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes is enough to wash and slice the leeks, shred the greens and grate the cheese, and the step timings add up to roughly the 20 cook minutes printed.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning appears in the steps, and nothing unlisted is used apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm pot of greens, leeks and beans suits early March, and the spring greens are a main component rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: Beans, eggs and greens with bread make a filling, balanced family lunch.
